mapper.sql: t.id, mountain_id, name, gpx_file_path, (select count(*) from recommends where track_id = t.id) as recommend_cnt
mapper.select: select from tracks t where name like CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
select from tracks t join favorites f on f.user_id = #{userId} and f.track_id = t.id
select from tracks t join recommends r on r.user_id = #{userId} and r.track_id = t.id
mapper.insert: insert into tracks(mountain_id, name, gpx_file_path) values(#{mountainId}, #{name}, #{gpxFilePath})
